name: Galle Face Green
description: Step outside the conference hotel for an oceanfront walk, sunset skies, kite-flying, and Colombo street-food favourites along the promenade.

image.alt: Crowds along Galle Face Green's oceanfront promenade with Galle Face Hotel and Colombo's skyline beyond

name: Red Mosque & Pettah
description: See the landmark red-and-white façade of Jami Ul-Alfar Mosque, then explore Pettah’s lively market streets. Dress respectfully and check visitor and prayer times.

image.alt: Red-and-white striped façade and minarets of Jami Ul-Alfar Mosque in Pettah

name: Independence Square
description: Walk the shaded grounds around Independence Memorial Hall, then continue through Cinnamon Gardens and Colombo’s nearby museum district.

image.alt: Independence Memorial Hall and its stone columns in Colombo

name: Colombo Lotus Tower views
description: Take in a broad view across the capital from Colombo’s observation tower. Check current opening hours and ticket arrangements before setting out.

image.alt: Wide view of Colombo's skyline from the Lotus Tower

name: Gangaramaya & Seema Malaka
description: Discover Buddhist art at Gangaramaya Temple and pause at lakeside Seema Malaka. Dress modestly and remove shoes in shrine areas.

image.alt: Golden Buddhist shrine at Seema Malaka beside Beira Lake in Colombo

name: Mount Lavinia Beach
description: Head south of central Colombo for a relaxed beach walk and an Indian Ocean sunset. Check local sea conditions before swimming.

image.alt: Wide sandy shoreline and ocean at Mount Lavinia Beach

name: Sigiriya
description: Climb the ancient rock citadel above forest and water gardens. Start early, bring water, and wear shoes suited to steep steps.

image.alt: Sigiriya rock fortress rising above the surrounding forest

name: Kandy
description: Explore the hill capital, walk beside Kandy Lake, and visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic. Dress modestly and check visitor hours.

image.alt: Kandy Lake with the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic beyond the water

name: Hill country
description: Slow down among cool green slopes, tea estates, and highland towns. The journey is part of the experience, so plan at least an overnight stay.

image.alt: Green tea plantations covering hillsides in the Sri Lankan highlands

name: Ella & Nine Arch Bridge
description: Pair hill-country viewpoints and walking trails with a visit to Nine Arch Bridge. Use marked paths and view the railway only from safe areas.

image.alt: Train crossing the stone arches of Nine Arch Bridge near Ella

name: Galle Fort
description: Wander historic ramparts, quiet lanes, courtyards, and lighthouse views where the old town meets the Indian Ocean.

image.alt: Aerial view of the ramparts, buildings, and coast at Galle Fort

name: Dambulla Cave Temple
description: Explore a hillside cave-temple complex filled with murals and Buddha images. Dress modestly and be prepared to remove your shoes.

image.alt: Buddha statues and painted walls inside Dambulla Cave Temple

name: Mirissa & the south coast
description: Unwind on palm-fringed beaches and small bays. Plan any sea excursion with a reputable operator and only when weather conditions allow.

image.alt: Palm-fringed sandy bay with turquoise water at Mirissa

name: Yala National Park
description: Join a responsible guided safari through varied coastal and forest landscapes. Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed, so enjoy the whole habitat.

image.alt: A mother elephant and calf in Yala National Park
